To maintain personal and business organization, manage daily to-dos, and adapt a simple tool for various project needs.

benefits.claim: Provides a clear, intuitive visual overview of tasks and projects through its board and card system.
Helps users stay highly organized for both personal and business tasks, significantly improving overall productivity.
Facilitates effective team collaboration by making it easy to share boards and keep everyone updated on project progress.

frictions.claim: Boards can become crowded and overwhelming, making them less effective for very large or complex projects.
Lacks advanced features for data manipulation, detailed reporting (e.g., ROI statistics), or sophisticated time management options.
While generally simple, there can be a learning curve to fully utilize all its capabilities, and some advanced customizations require paid access.
